# 1. Exam I Guidelines

* Exam questions are related to the topics covered in class (See Section 2)
* The duration of the exam is 1 hour (15 mins are allotted for exam logistics)
* The students are allowed only the following items during exam
  - Exam questions provided to them
  - Pen and/or Pencil to answer the questions
  - One Scientific Calculator
  - If student brings a backpack to the class, it MUST be kept away from the desk
    - All electronic devices (mobile phones, headphones, smartwatches etc. should be in the backpack)
    - Smart glasses are not allowed 
* The testing centers for Exam 1 are as follows:
  - In-class
    - Location: SWNG 
    - Time-slot: 11AM-12:15PM
  - Alternate Testing
    - IF REQUIRED, Students can take Exam 1 at the University Testing Center/SDRC/Remotely
      - It is the students responsibility to make all the necessary arrangements (location and time) before the Exam and notify the instructor


# 2. Exam I Topics
Students are expected to prepare for the following topics:

* <u>1. Sight Distance (SD)</u>  
  - 1.1 Stopping SD (SSD)    
  - 1.2 Decision SD (DSD)
* <u>2. Roadway Design</u>     
  - 2.1 Horizontal Curve Design 
    - 2.1.1 Alignment and its equations
    - 2.1.2 Superelevation 
    - 2.1.3 Min. Radius of Curve
    - 2.1.4 SSD on the curve
  - 2.2 Vertical Curve Design
    - 2.2.1 Alignment and its equations
    - 2.2.2 Min. length of Curve
    - 2.2.3 SSD on the curve
* <u>3. Traffic Stream Characteristics</u> 
  - 3.1 Macroscopic Variables
  - 3.4 Microscopic Variables
* <u>4. Traffic Flow Theory</u>
  - 4.1 Fundamental Identity Eq
  - 4.2 Traffic Stream Models
  - 4.3 Traffic Shockwave At Signalized Intersection
* <u>5. Traffic Control Devices</u>
  - 5.1 Intro to MUTCD Manual
  - 5.2 Traffic Signs, Markings, Traffic Signals
* <u>6. Statistical Applications in Transportation</u>
  - 6.1 Summarizing Data (Central Tendency, dispersion)
  - 6.2 Probability and Probability Distribution, 
  - 6.3 Hypothesis Testing
    - 6.3.1 Large sample inferences for two means
    - 6.3.2 Small sample inferences for two means
    - 6.3.3 Inferences for two variances
